name: harness-companion
description: Harness Engineering skill — evidence-backed feature pipeline for reliable AI coding environments

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed feature pipeline with status, audit, and handoff.
interface.longDescription: Harness Companion adds a structured engineering workflow: feature tracking via feature_list.json, evidence associations per feature, 7-subsystem health dashboard, 5-axis audit scoring, WIP=1 rule enforcement, SessionStart status injection, and Stop handoff warnings. It works across coding agents (Codex, Claude Code) through a core/adapter architecture.
defaultPrompt: Set up harness engineering for this project.
